about: RH2's away notifier as it ships (volter-ai/runhuman-2 34fdc937, apps/rh2/src/notify/away.ts sendToDevices): its own fetch posts one message per phone to Expo's push service (title, body, data.url, sound default) and counts the ok tickets; RH2 pins no Expo server SDK and sends no access token. Bruno's two phones register first through the World's devices door (expo-notifications on the phone, which no server API does). The clock advances a minute, past the service's delivery, and the readback reads what each phone shows through the inbox door, without sending again.

files..env.example: # RH2 sends Expo pushes without an access token (no enhanced push security)
